name: Maul
tagline: Workplace lunch menus and orders in Maul
description: Check your workplace’s lunch menus and orders in Maul. You can also place or cancel lunch orders if you enable changes.
examples: What's for lunch at work on Wednesday?
Order the vegetarian dish for Thursday.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show whether a Maul login is cached, for which email/location, and token expiry

tools.name: me
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's Maul profile

tools.name: menu
tools.description: Menu items for an ISO week (optionally one weekday), with item IDs

tools.name: orders
tools.description: The signed-in user's orders for an ISO week

tools.name: admin_orders
tools.description: All orders at the user's location for a date (Maul admin accounts only)

tools.name: order_submit
tools.description: Order one weekday by exact menu item ID with confirmation; refuses if that day already has an order

tools.name: order_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one weekday's order; confirmItemId must match the existing order

envVars.name: MAUL_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose order_submit and order_cancel

envVars.name: MAUL_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID
envVars.description: Override the Maul web app's public Cognito user pool ID

envVars.name: MAUL_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Override the Maul web app's public Cognito client ID

is.description: Skoðaðu matseðla og hádegismatarpantanir vinnustaðarins í Maul. Þú getur líka pantað eða afpantað mat ef þú leyfir breytingar.
examples: Hvað er í hádegismat í vinnunni á miðvikudaginn?
